summary: Home Nova responsiveness fix verification - ALL TESTS PASSED. Verified Nova launcher sizing, panel layout, and welcome content alignment across desktop (1920x1080), tablet (768x1024), and mobile (390x844) viewports. The root cause fix in NovaChatPanel.tsx correctly top-aligns welcome content when no meaningful conversation exists, eliminating the large dead zone above chat content.
critical_code_review_comments: NovaChatPanel.tsx fix is correct: justifyContent switches between 'flex-start' (welcome state) and 'flex-end' (conversation state) based on hasMeaningfulConversation
HomeNovaAssistantWidget.tsx correctly uses surfaceVariant='floating' which triggers the top-aligned welcome behavior
Launcher sizing is responsive: 52px (mobile), 58px (tablet), 64px (desktop) - all appropriate and not oversized
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nova responsiveness fix verified. Key fix: NovaChatPanel.tsx line 247 uses justifyContent: showGuidedWelcome ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end' to top-align welcome content. HomeNovaAssistantWidget uses surfaceVariant='floating'. Help and Settings Nova panels use surfaceVariant='embedded'. Both variants now correctly show top-aligned welcome content.

nova_panel.notes: Welcome content is top-aligned (161px offset < 250px threshold)

nova_closed_launcher_oversized.evidence: Desktop FAB is 64x64, tablet 58x58, mobile 52x52 - all appropriate sizes

nova_opened_panel_dead_zone.evidence: Welcome content offset from panel top is 161px (well under 250px threshold), confirming top-alignment

chat_input_and_send_visible.evidence: Both chat input and send button are visible on all tested viewports

root_cause_analysis.original_issue: Home floating Nova always seeded an assistant welcome message, so NovaChatPanel falsely rendered like an active conversation (messages.length > 0) and pushed visible content to the bottom with justifyContent: 'flex-end', creating a huge empty dead zone above.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: NovaChatPanel now uses hasMeaningfulConversation check (messages.some(msg => msg.role === 'user' || !!msg.message_id) || messages.length > 1) to determine if content should be bottom-aligned. When showGuidedWelcome is true (no meaningful conversation), content is top-aligned with justifyContent: 'flex-start'.
files_changed: /app/frontend/src/components/help/NovaChatPanel.tsx - Added hasMeaningfulConversation logic and conditional justifyContent
/app/frontend/src/components/home/HomeNovaAssistantWidget.tsx - Uses surfaceVariant='floating' to trigger correct behavior
